# Incident Command

Every hazard response, regardless of type, should operate under a single
incident command structure with a clearly designated incident commander and
a documented chain of communication to affected-area authorities.

## Public Warning Dissemination

Public warnings should be issued through redundant channels — broadcast,
cell alert and community sirens where available — so that a failure in any
single channel does not leave a population uninformed of an approaching
hazard, whatever its type.
